visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed row of expanding image panes, one per topic, the active one wide with headline, text and button
traits: panes side by side from 768px, stacked below; active pane 5 shares (4 at tablet), others 1
first pane active; click or mouse hover makes a pane active, 0.5s flex transition
overlay colour multiplied onto every image
tab label at the bottom left of every pane; headline, text and white outlined button on the active pane

contentPattern.structure: One row per pane. Cell 1: image. Cell 2: H2 tab label, H3 headline, optional text, link (button). Optional config row Overlay | colour

usage.description: Travel class panes on the hub pages food-and-beverages / speisen-und-getraenke and lufthansa-travel-classes / lufthansa-reiseklassen (Lufthansa .herobanner).

reuseGuidance: Use for a small number (3 to 5) of image topics that expand on interaction. For a single full-bleed stage use hero-campaign; for a row of static image teasers use cards-teaser.
